notes.title: DLC2 MIND PALACE for Monkey King: Hero is Back Available Now!
notes.content:
The Great Sage held a secret while he was sealed inside the crystal for all those centuries... namely, the fact that he was actually training diligently! Despite being cast away in a crystal deep inside the elemental mountains by none other than the Buddha himself, the Great Sage never gave up! Experience this training for yourself as it unfolds in a series of missions across action-packed stages that are filled with gimmicks and traps different from those found in the main game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662107/dae724df7c54046d73d70863a66271f54cf9375f.jpg[/img]

notes.title: New DLC & Major Update
notes.content:
Play through the dramatic opening events of MONKEY KING: HERO IS BACK for yourself as Sun Wukong and the Eastern Gods wage a ferocious battle in the heavens in cinematic action game form! 

New DLC "UPROAR IN HEAVEN" arrives! Please check the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/967240/MONKEY_KING_HERO_IS_BACK/]store page[/url] to learn more and download it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662107/88818e04226734c1deeaa848a06bb660c6a609fa.jpg[/img]

We also bring a patch for improve the performance of the game, please see the patch notes for what's new.

Patch Notes:

-Frame Rate Unlock for smoother experience

-Deleted black screens while climbing ladders for smoother experience

-Removed majority of ‘dotted lines’ to move seamless through the level 

-Fixed ‘disappearing’ Monkey King Bug

-Shorten the loading time when changing different scenes.

Finally, We strongly suggest you update the patch before start enjoying the DLC.

notes.title: About Language Setting (Concerns Players Before Oct. 19th)
notes.content:
Recently, we have received some complaints about the default language setting. Reported that the default language was all in Chinese, and it was not in line with users’ device or Steam language. We have fixed this issue and launch a patch already. However, the patch would only support users who downloaded and installed the game after Oct. 19th. Those who still have this problem please check the instruction below to reset your language in game.

Change Language in Game:
1.	Select the second option on the main screen of the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662107/55cc3c28c94d2e0c7fa54909037564bc57df545f.jpg[/img]

2.	Select the fifth button in the “Options”, that is the language setting, and you will see there are 2 options displayed on the right side, the upper one is the “Voice Language” and the other one is “Text Language”, choose “英语” to make it display all in English.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662107/694060b2f80041ea148d13f9490eb62cb531bea4.png[/img]

3.	You are all good with the language change.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662107/2fb53f9bc92e26d9a29930bd9256cf4c30e889da.png[/img]

OR you can change it another way

Change language setting on Steam Client:
1.	Right click the game “Monkey King: Hero is Back” and choose the “Properties”.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662107/3a32ddb65b6868af720a63e42d65b00e30658c76.jpg[/img]

2.	Click the “Language” and select the language you are looking for.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662107/fc143ddc5a53cb4d690c169e165f0077e8b6bdcb.png[/img]

3.	Done with the language setting and enjoy the game.

    We would like to notice all the players again, if the game was installed after Oct. 19th, there is no need to change the language, all the language will display in line with your system language.

    We are sorry for the inconvenience it brought to all the players, and we are working on the optimization of the game, and hopefully we will bring more fun to all the players.

notes.title: MONKEY KING: HERO IS BACK's new SKU plan in Mainland, China
notes.content:
MONKEY KING: HERO IS BACK on Steam in Mainland, China has been in discount for a while, and will restore the prices officially.

Standard Edition: Current Price: 149 RMB    Official Price: 199 RMB
Deluxe Edition: Current Price: 299 RMB     Official Price: 349 RMB
